scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a sentimental mother's April birthday, [X] considers a birthstone necklace and compares low-cost diamond-look or tiny-stone options, lab-grown and natural diamonds, chain metals, certification, and ready-made versus semi-custom or fully custom work, deciding which parts of a higher quote carry lasting personal value.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为重感情、出生于四月的母亲挑选生日项链时，[X]会比较低价仿钻或小钻方案、培育钻与天然钻、链条金属、证书，以及成品、半定制和完全定制，并判断更高报价中的哪些部分真正承载了持久的个人意义。
examples: choosing a small certified or lab-grown stone within a moderate gift budget
paying for engraving or a meaningful setting instead of greater carat weight
asking whether reusing a family stone makes custom labor worthwhile

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning an intimate birthday date under one all-in budget, [X] selects a specific heart pendant and recalculates dinner, flowers, delivery, and a contingency buffer around its actual price, checking whether the branded piece remains affordable without weakening the rest of the celebration.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一笔总预算内筹划两人的生日约会时，[X]会选中一款具体的心形吊坠，再围绕它的实际价格重新核算晚餐、鲜花、配送和应急余量，并确认这件品牌首饰不会挤压庆祝活动的其他部分。
examples: locking in the pendant after the complete date still retains a buffer
choosing a less expensive piece when food and flowers are non-negotiable
checking the final bill rather than treating each purchase in isolation

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After finding a delicate floral necklace from an independent online maker for [X]'s mother and considering a luxury candle to accompany it, [X] compares local consultation, marketplace customization, department-store promotions, shipping and return terms, and whether the second gift leaves enough budget for workmanship and personalization in the necklace itself.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在独立设计师平台上为母亲找到一条精致的花卉项链、又考虑搭配高档香薰蜡烛时，[X]会比较本地面谈、线上定制、百货促销、配送与退货条件，并判断第二件礼物是否会挤占项链工艺和个性化所需的预算。
examples: using a promotion while preserving the chosen customization
paying a local jeweler more when consultation reduces remake risk
dropping the luxury add-on rather than compromising the main keepsake

scenarios.scenario_abstract: To create the greatest outfit impact from a small accessories budget, [X] compares thrifted jewelry, inexpensive store pieces, and self-made beaded bracelets or charm combinations by material cost, time, uniqueness, durability, and how many existing school outfits each option can refresh.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了用有限的配饰预算获得最大的穿搭变化，[X]会按材料成本、制作时间、独特性、耐用性和可搭配现有校园服装的数量，比较二手首饰、平价成品以及自己制作的串珠手链或吊饰组合。
examples: making one distinctive bracelet from low-cost components
buying a thrifted piece after checking its clasp and wear
spending slightly more on a versatile item that replaces several trend purchases

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With a fixed total for a mother's birthday gift and knowing that she walks often, dresses casually, and loves purple, [X] compares modest amethyst-colored necklaces or earrings with other useful gifts and reserves enough of the budget for comfortable metal, everyday wear, and a reversible choice if the jewelry does not suit her.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在固定总预算内为母亲准备生日礼物时，[X]知道她常散步、穿着休闲并喜欢紫色，因此会把价格适中的紫水晶色项链或耳饰与其他实用礼物比较，同时为舒适金属、日常佩戴和不合适时可退换留出预算。
examples: choosing a modest purple-toned piece that fits her daily style
paying more for a comfortable metal and dependable return policy
switching to a non-jewelry gift when the suitable piece would exceed the total

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After buying several natural-crystal bracelets, [X] reviews what each piece can safely tolerate before spending on powders, cleaning supplies, or additional crystals, treating fading, heat, salt or water damage, restringing, and premature replacement as part of the jewelry's real ownership price rather than accepting every maintenance claim at face value.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 买了几条天然水晶手链后，[X]会在继续购买石粉、清洁用品或更多水晶前，先核实每件现有首饰能安全承受什么，并把褪色、高温、盐水或清水损伤、重新穿线和过早更换都计入真实持有成本，而不是照单全收各种养护说法。
examples: using a free material-safe routine instead of an unnecessary cleansing product
paying for restringing when the owned bracelet is worth preserving
avoiding a cheap replacement whose stone treatment or care limits are unclear

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a short Shanghai trip after an esports event, [X] adds a Tianzifang stop and considers handmade jewelry as a compact souvenir, comparing studio and stall prices by identifiable maker, material, finish, portability, tourist markup, and the amount left for transport, food, and the rest of the city walk.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在上海观看电竞赛事后的短途行程中，[X]会加入田子坊一站，并考虑把手工首饰作为便携纪念品；报价会依据作者是否可追溯、材质、做工、便携性和游客溢价来比较，同时顾及交通、餐饮和后续城市漫步的余款。
examples: buying a modest signed piece directly from a local maker
asking what material or handwork explains a higher studio quote
walking away when a generic souvenir consumes too much of the trip budget

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After assembling an affordable minimalist outfit around a white top, slim jeans, and sneakers, [X] considers one delicate pearl necklace and judges whether a low-cost fashion version or a better-finished piece offers the right value through clasp quality, surface wear, repeat styling, and cost relative to the core clothes.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 用白色上衣、修身牛仔裤和运动鞋组成一套平价极简穿搭后，[X]会考虑加入一条精致的珍珠项链，并根据扣件质量、表面耐磨、重复搭配次数以及相对基础服装的花费，判断平价时尚款还是做工更好的款式更值。
examples: choosing an inexpensive necklace for occasional outfit variation
paying more for reliable finishing when it will anchor many looks
skipping a costly version that overwhelms an otherwise affordable wardrobe

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a husband's birthday, [X] wants an everyday keepsake that says the family will always support him and compares engravable bracelets with other personalized items, asking how metal, inscription length, sizing, daily durability, and return restrictions affect the quote before choosing sentiment over mere brand prestige.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为丈夫准备生日礼物时，[X]希望用一件可日常佩戴的纪念物表达家人会一直支持他，因此会把可刻字手链与其他个性化物品比较，并在选择情感意义而非单纯品牌溢价前，了解金属、刻字长度、尺寸、日常耐用性和退货限制如何影响报价。
examples: choosing a simple engraved bracelet when the message matters most
paying more for a metal that tolerates daily wear
rejecting a costly branded option that adds no useful personalization

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For graduation in a pink floral dress with chest ruffles, [X] wants a formal, glamorous finish and allocates the jewelry budget toward statement earrings, a simple bracelet, or a restrained ring rather than a competing necklace, balancing one-day impact, ceremony-long comfort, finish, and later rewear.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 毕业时将穿一条胸前带荷叶边的粉色花卉连衣裙，[X]希望整体既正式又华丽，因此会把首饰预算优先分配给醒目耳饰、简洁手链或克制的戒指，而不是与领口冲突的项链，并权衡典礼当天的效果、佩戴舒适、做工和日后复用。
examples: spending most of the accessory budget on one pair of earrings
choosing a simpler reusable bracelet instead of several event-only pieces
avoiding an expensive necklace that competes with the ruffled neckline
